Ein Auge, keine Waffe. Verkürzt den Anfl: One eye, not a weapon. Shortens the approach of each dive and extends the range of the depth probe by one depth. Does not contribute to attack or defense, either in the abyss or elsewhere.
Eine schwimmende Druckhülle. Senkt die e: It's a floating pressure shell. It lowers your ship's losses on dives the more you fly -- up to a boundary. Almost no attack value; the boiler doesn't win a fight; it brings the fleet home.
Ersetzt den Frachter unten: Er trägt deu: Replaces the freighter at the bottom: it carries significantly more cargo than a large freighter and additionally lifts the amount of raw materials recovered, without which part of the loot remains in the sector from medium depth.
Seine Kampfkraft hängt nicht an seiner B: Its fighting power does not depend on its design, but on its location: the deeper the sector, the stronger it strikes. At shallow depths it is weaker than a fighter, at the bottom the most effective weapon you can take with you. This makes the choice of fleet for the first time dependent on the depth, acting only in the abyss.
Dämpft alle Sektorbedingungen, die den A: Dampens all the sector conditions that prolong the approach — gravitational funnel, resonance vein, magnetic clamp and crystal throat lose some of their effect. Erhöht die Ausbeute an Abgrundsplittern: Increases the yield of abyss shards on each dive, the more they fly. It pays off not in one evening, but over weeks - and is therefore the only reason to dive a comfortable depth again, instead of always wanting to dive deeper. Acts only in the abyss.
Steigert deine Kampfkraft ausschließlich: It doesn't work for any other sector, because guards give four times the amount of salvage, it makes it possible to take the dives that are the most worthwhile.
Streicht einen Mutator des Sektors, ohne: Eliminate a sector mutator without you having chosen a countermeasure, unlike the spell coil, which doubles an already selected spell. Acts only from 25 on board and then completely: half a mutator does not exist. acts only in the abyss.
Hebt den Abschlag auf wiederholte Tauchg: Raise the tee on repeated dives as more of them fly: a long-defeated depth returns to 35% instead of 70%, so that each depth remains permanently usable instead of only once. The ground touch cancels the tee for a single dive completely - the basic diver does it permanently, but only partially. Acts only in the abyss.

Du übernimmst eine kleine Außenposten-Ko: You take on a small outpost colony at the edge of the Kepler system. Build resource production, explore technology, build a fleet and explore the galaxy - this short tour shows the most important areas.
Im Basis-Tab baust du Gebäude, die Energ: In the base tab, you build buildings that produce energy, ore, crystals, deuterium and antimatter. Almost every building, ship and research expansion costs energy, among other things - remove solar cells early on, otherwise you will soon lack the small change for everything else.
Im Forschung-Tab verbesserst du Produkti: In the Research Tab, you can improve production, combat power and more permanently. In the late game, you can also choose a doctrine – a strategic principle decision for the entire empire – one decides about attack and defense, the other about support, expeditions and the abyss.
Im Offiziere-Tab wartet dein Ausrüstungs: In the Officers tab, your equipment kit is waiting for you. Seven officers are constantly reinforcing your empire - all active, hired and promoted simultaneously with command points that you earn for fighting. Two modular systems: location modules are in the slots of a planet (production, defense, warehouse and more), ship class modules act on every ship of a class, no matter where it stands. Modules are eight rarities from common to primordial, each find rolls its main value and its secondary values. Three similar finds merge to the next higher rarity, surplus ones you disassemble into fragments and make your desired module. Saved templates change entire equipment profiles with one click - the change preview shows what changes beforehand.
Im Flotte-Tab baust du Schiffe. Im Galax: In the Fleet Tab, you build ships. In the Galaxy Tab, you attack NPC opponents or other players - you put the Attack Fleet together directly on the Attack Button. A scouting ship can conveniently detect the enemy's strength before an attack.
Im Sektorkarte-Tab siehst du zuerst die: In the sector map tab, you first see the galaxy as eight named sector regions. Tap a region, then the sector shows its systems; a tap on a system folds its planets — a click on a planet opens a small menu of exploration and colonization. Belt systems have a dashed gold ring — fold such a system, then its asteroids lie on the belt orbit, and a click on a chunk sends a mining mission (research mining technology necessary).
Im Allianz-Tab schließt du dich mit ande: In the Alliance tab, you join forces with others for common technologies, buildings, and even wars against other alliances.
Neben Ressourcen gibt es Kredite als Han: In addition to resources, there are credits as a trading currency – for this you do not need a factory, but activity. The most reliable source is trade routes (market tab): once set up, they provide credits all the time. Added to this are the sale of surplus resources in the market, the rewards of the day tasks, faction orders, successes, conquered star systems and the Shadow Bund as an ally. They are spent in the credit shop, for tributes, in the market and for individual buildings such as the embassy district.
Unter Ressourcen- und Werkstoff-Zeile li: Under Resources and Materials line are the daily tasks: five are pulled daily from 25 templates, across all areas – combat, research, construction, market, expeditions, factions, modules, and with unlocked abyss also dives. Each gives resources or credits, and whoever picks them up in one day gets a series bonus that grows over several complete days. You can tap an open task to jump directly to the matching menu. This is the fastest way to get to know the game: the tasks guide you through all systems by themselves.
Im Galaxie-Tab stehen vier NPC-Fraktione: In the galaxy tab, there are four NPC factions: Ash Cartel, Iron Legion, Void Marauders and Shadow League. Each of them climbs to eight ranks, each of which has its own name - in the cartel from supplicant to syndicate partner. From rank 6 ("Friendly"), a faction gives you its effect and opens its shop, paying with favors from their orders instead of credits. Popularity is not possible: the four form two pairs of rivals. And reputation must be maintained - three days without contact, and it sinks again, if you do not maintain an embassy there. Enmity, on the other hand, has real disadvantages.
Im Galaxie-Tab wartet mehr als PvP: Jage: In the Galaxy Tab, there is more than PvP: hunt with all players together the world boss "Leviathan of the Void", smoke out pirate hideouts (level 1-10), fight for league rewards in the weekly league and make non-attack pacts with other players (peace dividend: +5% production per pact, count several pacts).

Erhöht die Lagerkapazität dieses Standor: Increases storage at this location, scaling with your Abyss depth record: the base value at depth 0, twice as much at depth 40 and four times as much from depth 120. A Pressure Tank found early therefore remains useful.
Verlängert die Lebensdauer aufgefangener: Extends the lifetime of newly received bearings empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together. Bearings normally expire after two hours. Schmilzt einen Teil des geborgenen <stro: Converts part of recovered salvage into additional module fragments. Each successful dive gives fragments equal to 30% of its salvage, summed empire-wide. You keep all the salvage itself; the furnace adds fragments without taking anything away.
Verstärkt die Verteidigung dieses Stando: Strengthens this location's defense only against NPC attacks from pirates, raiders or faction fleets, and only when you are outmatched. Verkürzt die Dauer einer <strong>Terrafo: Reduces the duration of a terraforming stage at this location. Fully upgraded, it saves about 18 hours across all ten stages. Capped at −30%. It only works where equipped, since each location has its own terraforming project.
Erhöht die Ausbeute, die deine <strong>R: Increases the yield your recyclers recover from debris fields empire-wide. Contributions from all locations are added together, capped at +45%. It does not increase the debris field itself, only what you recover from it.
Erhöht das <strong>Prisengut</strong>, d: Increases the prize cargo recovered from a captured ship empire-wide, capped at +40%. It affects the proceeds only, not capture slots or boarding chance.
